_approach: The melodic/European strand where pads carry as much as percussion: only four drum parts. 4x4 kick, clap layered with rim on 2 and 4, a soft full 16th shaker, offbeat open hats and a single low-conga phrase at the end of the second bar. Orphiq: count the percussion parts in a Keinemusik record - the number is smaller than it sounds. Ref: Keinemusik 'Muyè' (2020), Adam Port 'Move' (2024). (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
